_readme: AI Credit Tag sponsor feed. Edit this file to change what appears in the
extension. Live within 6 hours, no extension update needed.
TO SWITCH SOMETHING OFF: set "enabled": false on that item.
TO SWITCH IT BACK ON: set "enabled": true, or delete the line.
JSON has no comments, so this flag is how you disable things.
banners  = the picture. Only one shows at a time.
notice   = the text links under it, shown in the order listed.
label    = the corner tag. Defaults to Ad. Use "none" for your own
non-promotional links, such as a tutorial.
weight   = share of impressions when several banners are enabled.
starts / ends = ISO dates. Outside the window the item is skipped.
Anything the extension does not recognise, including this _readme, is ignored.
After editing, wait a few minutes for GitHub Pages to republish.
